mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(input_tokens) AS inputTokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS outputTokens, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE input_tokens IS NULL OR output_tokens IS NULL) AS untrackedCallCount FROM llm_usage WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{toExclusive}

SELECT feature AS feature, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(input_tokens) AS inputTokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS outputTokens, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE input_tokens IS NULL OR output_tokens IS NULL) AS untrackedCallCount FROM llm_usage WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{toExclusive} GROUP BY feature

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS usageDate, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(input_tokens) AS inputTokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS outputTokens, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE input_tokens IS NULL OR output_tokens IS NULL) AS untrackedCallCount FROM llm_usage WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{toExclusive} GROUP BY DATE(created_at)

SELECT model_name AS modelName, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(input_tokens) AS inputTokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS outputTokens FROM llm_usage WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{toExclusive} GROUP BY model_name

SELECT user_seq AS userSeq, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(input_tokens) AS inputTokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS outputTokens, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE input_tokens IS NULL OR output_tokens IS NULL) AS untrackedCallCount FROM llm_usage WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{toExclusive} GROUP BY user_seq ORDER BY (COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0)) DESC, user_seq LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
